title: Super Micro fiscal Q1 2027 results (call 5 p.m. ET) — the AI-server builder reports in the same after-close window as AMD
source: EST: Super Micro's own 8-K Exhibit 99.1 dated 2026-10-20 (sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000025/smcifirstquarterfy2027busi.htm), fetched direct 2026-10-30: 'earnings call Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET / 2:00 p.m. PT'; the same release pre-announces Q1 FY2027 revenue of $18.5B to $19.5B. notes: Discovered during the amd-fq3-2026-results-2026-11-03 pulse (2026-10-30).
